 Hylo Open 2026: Lakshya Sen & PV Sindhu win Men’s and Women’s Singles titles
 Lakshya Sen and PV Sindhu won their respective men’s and women’s singles titles at the Hylo Open 2026 in Saarbrucken yesterday, bringing home double badminton glory for India.  
 PV Sindhu became the first Indian woman to win the Hylo Open women’s singles crown, beating Denmark’s Line Kjaersfeldt 21-12, 21-14 in the final. 
 Entering her second BWF tournament final in as many weeks, double Olympic medallist Sindhu dominated the game to clinch her first title since the Japan Open in July.  
 On the other hand, Lakshya defeated defending champion Jonatan Christie of Indonesia 21-17, 21-10 to win the Hylo Open men’s singles crown for the second time. It is Lakshya’s first BWF title of the year and makes him the first Indian to win two titles at the Hylo Open.
